content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was an incorrect size comparison in the `parse_lfp_backlight` function due to an increase in the size of the `bdb_lfp_backlight_data` structure after a previous patch. This caused the condition that checks if the size of the backlight data structure retrieved from the BDB was sufficient to always fail for older BDB versions, leading to improper handling of backlight data for those versions. The patch corrects this by calculating the expected size based on the BDB version and comparing it accordingly.
